title: prunella vulgaris subsp. laciniata
intro: Prunella vulgaris subsp. laciniata, commonly known as self-heal, is a subspecies of the Prunella vulgaris plant, a member of the Lamiaceae family. It is a perennial herb that has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, valued for its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of self-heal include wound healing, immune system support, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Prunella vulgaris subsp. laciniata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
